description: Saves a Texas site (address or lat/lng) with a radius to the signed-in user's watched sites. Each Monday morning the user gets one email listing what changed within the radius (battery storage milestones, generation queue entries, TCEQ air permits including data centers, new planned grid projects, geolocated news within the radius or in the same county), only in weeks when something did. Use when the user asks to watch, monitor or track a site or to be told when something changes near it. Only call it when the user asked. Pass id (from list_saved_sites) to change a watched site's name, location, radius or weekly_email. Pro and up, 25 sites; free accounts get an explanation and nothing is saved. Different from save_place, which only pins a point on the map.

address.description: Texas street address or place. Pass this or lat/lng.

id.description: Existing watched site id to update.

radius_mi.description: Watch radius in miles. Default 10, 0.5 to 50.

weekly_email.description: Include in the Monday email. Default true.

name: save_site
title: Watch a site for weekly changes (Pro)
